query: the best way to get rid of squarrels
plausible_answers: Exclusion: seal entry points around the house / attic
Live or kill trapping with corn / peanut butter bait, timed for just after hibernation
Repellents: mothballs, homemade water-based spray, or the Squirrel Evictor product
baseline_answer: Exclusion: seal entry points around the house / attic
